2707-4872-5795.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1170-2099-5131-8176--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-5131-8176--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2187-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2187-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
2187-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Possessed Skaab and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

3899-4381--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

997-2738-4556-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

431-851-6753-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-6753-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1245-1475-2595.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-2595.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2

3240-6462-6798-7396.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-3771-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

457-1458-4404-7646.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-7646.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Krallenhorde Howler.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

4377-5913-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

914-3335-7297.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3335-7297.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-3335-7297.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

275-2034-3375-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Immortal Sun.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-4089.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Glasspool Mimic
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Glasspool Mimic by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4693-5478-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp, that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
4693-5478-5721-6883.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

339-677-2034-3480.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3951-5703-5929-6753.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-5703-5929-6753.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2558-3490-3698-5231-6701.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-3698-5231-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

687-1478-4929-5641-5684.notablePrerequisites: If Sakura-Tribe Elder is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Sakura-Tribe Elder is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-1478-4929-5641-5684.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Elder by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Sakura-Tribe Elder.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Sakura-Tribe Elder and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-1478-4929-5641-5684.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

159-228-4871-6291.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to 1.
159-228-4871-6291.description:
Activate Skullclamp by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Skullclamp and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2921-3951-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2921-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

803-2097-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-1974-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Quicksilver Gargantuan has a power of at least 2.
1912-1974-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Quicksilver Gargantuan and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Quicksilver Gargantuan from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Quicksilver Gargantuan to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Quicksilver Gargantuan enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

74-943-1460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
74-943-1460.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Vault of Catlacan.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Vault of Catlacan.
Repeat.
74-943-1460.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Vault of Catlacan instead.

2792-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}.
2792-5900.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-5900.notes: If up to seven lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1235-3581-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

575-4050-4489.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using {G} and one colored mana.
575-4050-4489.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the creature face-up, allowing you to play the creature from exile this turn.
Cast the creature from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the creature can be cast using one or less mana, this combo nets infinite mana.

3263-4659-4679.notablePrerequisites:
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Aura.
3263-4659-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of an Aura you control, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Aura token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

331-2773-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

147-3495-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3495-4050.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3495-4050.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

88-444-779-2894.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
88-444-779-2894.description:
Attempt to draw a card.
The card draw is replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, causing you instead to discard Dakmor Salvage, then mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Skola Grovedancer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver  triggers, attempting to cause you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

930-2034-4082-4763.notablePrerequisites: Universal Automaton has at least one Equipment attached.
930-2034-4082-4763.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Universal Automaton dies, triggering Koll, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {2}.
Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, triggering Kemba, attaching any Equipment you control to it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-3652-5222-5256.description:
Cast Ornithopter.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Ornithopter for {0}.
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Altar of Dementia to mill target player two.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Ornithopter to your hand.
Repeat.

816-3111.description:
Cast Rune-Tail, Kitsune Ascendant.
Rune-Tail, Kitsune Ascendant flips due to having 30 or more life.
Since creatures can not take damage and Protector of the Crown prevents you from taking damage, you are unable to take damage.

914-1409.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Dockside Extortionist.
914-1409.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1409.description:
Activate Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Dockside Extortionist.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
914-1409.notes: If opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite mana and Treasure tokens.
